verdict.rationale: Statsig ships Dynamic Configs as a first-class entity alongside Feature Gates. Their values can be retrieved via the HTTP API and SDKs, managed via the CLI, and scoped by target apps. Experiments serve multiple variants (A/B/n), and the docs show configuration values such as model type and prompt settings being served. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the supported value types (strings, numbers, JSON objects), detailed docs on non-boolean multivariate flag setup, and independent hands-on corroboration.
